task: Draft the item labels for a right-click context menu in a fictional macOS document management application. The menu appears on a selected document. Use only the supplied action facts and preserve the supplied order and labeling conventions.

facts.text: Open opens the document in the default editor.
Rename lets the user rename the document inline.
Move to Folder… opens a folder-picker sheet (ellipsis indicates a follow-up sheet).
Duplicate creates a copy of the document in the same folder.
Move to Trash moves the document to the system Trash; this is not a permanent deletion.
The items appear in this order: Open, Rename, Move to Folder…, Duplicate, Move to Trash.

forbidden_additions: An invented menu item not from the supplied facts.
A reordering of the six items.
Delete Permanently as a label when the fact specifies Move to Trash.
preserve: All six items in the supplied order.
Ellipsis in Move to Folder… indicating a follow-up sheet.
Move to Trash as distinct from permanent deletion.
